name: io.github.Shubh-Sgr/pgvouch
title: PgVouch
description: Safe PostgreSQL migrations: schema drift, lock analysis, safe rewrites, data checksums. Read-only.

environmentVariables.name: SOURCE_DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Read-only postgres:// URL of the reference database

environmentVariables.name: TARGET_DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Read-only postgres:// URL of the database to check

environmentVariables.name: PGVOUCH_LLM
environmentVariables.description: Optional planner LLM: none (default), ollama or gemini
